title: Mud Pig
lines: Sam has a big pig and a red tub.
The pig naps in the hot sun.
It gets up and runs to the mud.
Sam gets the tub and a big rag.
He rubs and rubs. The pig sits in it.
The pig is wet. Sam is wet!
"You can nap in the sun," said Sam.

questions.ask: What does Sam use to get the pig clean?
questions.listenFor: A tub and a big rag. This one is stated right in the story — if they cannot find it, have them reread that line rather than telling them.

questions.ask: Why is Sam wet at the end?
questions.listenFor: Looking for cause and effect: Sam washed the pig in the tub, so Sam got wet too. If they just say "the tub," ask "and what happened in the tub?"

questions.ask: Which part will you draw — the pig in the mud, or the pig in the tub?
questions.listenFor: Either, as long as they say what made them pick it. Line three is the mud; line six is the tub.
